import pathlib,tomllib,json,re
d=tomllib.loads(pathlib.Path(r'research/nima/contracts/typed-response.v1.toml').read_text())
T,U,Y,F=d['tables'],d['unions'],d['types'],d['field_sets']
assert all('allowed' not in t for t in T.values()) and 'allowed' not in d['root']
ids=[c['id'] for c in d['constraints']]; rules=[re.sub(r'\\s+',' ',c['rule'].strip().lower()) for c in d['constraints']]
assert len(ids)==len(set(ids)) and len(rules)==len(set(rules))
assert 'has_attention' not in str(d) and 'has_context' not in str(d)
sigs={}
for n,t in T.items():
 sig=json.dumps({k:t.get(k) for k in ('field_set','required','optional','constants','fields')},sort_keys=True)
 assert sig not in sigs,(n,'duplicate-table-schema',sigs.get(sig)); sigs[sig]=n
type_sigs={}
for n,t in Y.items():
 sig=json.dumps(t,sort_keys=True)
 assert sig not in type_sigs,(n,'duplicate-type',type_sigs.get(sig)); type_sigs[sig]=n
referenced={'operator','agent'}; changed=True
while changed:
 changed=False
 for n in list(referenced):
  t=T[n]
  for s in t.get('fields',{}).values():
   ref=s.get('schema_ref')
   if ref and ref not in referenced: referenced.add(ref); changed=True
   ir=s.get('item_schema_ref')
   if ir in T and ir not in referenced: referenced.add(ir); changed=True
   if ir in U:
    for v in U[ir]['variants']:
     if v not in referenced: referenced.add(v); changed=True
assert set(T)==referenced,('unreachable-tables',set(T)-referenced)
for fsn,fs in F.items():
 users=[t for t in T.values() if t.get('field_set')==fsn]
 used=set().union(*(set(t.get('required',[]))|set(t.get('optional',[])) for t in users))
 constants=set().union(*(set(t.get('constants',{})) for t in users))
 assert set(fs)==used-constants,(fsn,'unused-or-missing-field-types',set(fs)^(used-constants))
print('redundancy-pass',len(referenced),len(sigs),len(type_sigs),len(rules))
